newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 falls on weak demand.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 falls on weak demand.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices fell in slow late trading on Friday due to continued weak demand, dealers said.
Dealers said January SIR20 offer prices fell 0.25-0.50 cents/lb to 55.25-55.75 cents fob Medan, 55.00-55.50 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang, 54.25-54.75 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
One Padang dealer said Japanese firms bought January SIR20 at 54.50 cents late on Thursday with offtakes in small quantity.
Dealers said prompt delivery latex was on offer at 2,150 rupiah/kg against the previous 2,200 rupiah due to weak demand.
January SIR3CV was last traded at 141 cents/kg, they said.
